🚨 MULTI-THEATER OPERATIONS: ISRAEL TARGETS IRAN’S MISSILE NETWORK AS REGIONAL MILITARY AND DIPLOMATIC PRESSURE BUILDS 🕑 March 25, 2026 | 2:00 AM 🎯 Israel Front: Fatalities, Impacts, and Civilian Effects: A woman in her 30s was killed near Mahanayim Junction after a rocket impact caused severe multi-system trauma, according to MDA. In Safed, two individuals were lightly injured by glass shards following a ballistic missile impact and did not require hospitalization. 💥 Central Israel: Cluster Munition Strike and Damage: One Iranian ballistic missile carried a cluster warhead, dispersing multiple bomblets across central Israel. MDA reported nine wounded in Bnei Brak, including one in moderate condition, while additional impacts in Petah Tikva caused damage without injuries. 🏠 Home Front Impact and Emergency Response: Residential buildings were damaged, including a direct strike on a reinforced safe room that absorbed the impact without harming those inside. Search and rescue teams are operating at multiple sites, with the public instructed to avoid gathering and follow Home Front Command guidance. ⚠️ Home Front Command Restrictions: Nationwide directives remain in effect with limits on gatherings, education, and workplaces based on proximity to protected spaces. Stricter measures apply in higher-risk regions, where educational activity is fully suspended. 💥 Iran Theater: Strategic Air Campaign and Infrastructure Targeting: The Israeli Air Force conducted large-scale strikes in Isfahan targeting key explosives production facilities linked to weapons development. Across Iran, dozens of additional targets were struck using over 120 munitions, including missile launch sites, production facilities, and air defense systems. 🚀 Missile Program Degradation and Operational Pressure: More than 600 sorties have been carried out against Iran’s ballistic missile infrastructure since the start of Operation “Roaring Lion.” Real-time targeting has focused on launchers, including those prepared for immediate use. 🎯 Targeted Elimination of Launch Cells: An Iranian missile cell responsible for fire toward Arad was identified and eliminated in an airstrike. The operation reflects a broader effort to systematically target launch crews and command structures. 🛰️ IRGC Internal Strain and Reduced Effectiveness: IDF intelligence indicates weakening missile units, with reports of fatigue, low morale, and absenteeism among personnel. Some members are reportedly refusing deployment to launch sites amid sustained targeting operations. 🌊 Strait of Hormuz: Escalation and Maritime Response: A UK-led coalition is preparing to reopen the Strait of Hormuz with mine-clearing support from the U.S. and France. Bahrain has proposed a UN resolution authorizing force to secure shipping routes, while the Philippines declared an energy emergency. 📡 Iran Messaging on Maritime Passage: Iran signaled that “non-hostile ships” may pass through the strait without clarifying criteria. The message comes amid rising concern over global energy and shipping disruption. 💬 Join the discussion and follow: https://t.co/BQWrl2ekEx ⏱️ If this update was helpful, please forward it to someone who relies on real-time information from Israel. 👉 WhatsApp – Digest Summaries: https://t.co/mFoqAfflbY 👉 Telegram — Digest Summaries: https://t.co/u9LhsUjzTx 🌐 Read on web & subscribe by email: https://t.co/RUPHrfDmSl ☕ Support independent reporting: https://t.co/SdSJ7FFTdV

FIRE SPREADS IN THE WEST

#MSNews | A 3rd Alarm fire occurred in a residential area in Barangay Western Bicutan, Taguig City.

Manila Standard Reporter and Fire Volunteer, Vince Lopez, together with his colleagues in Barangay Pinagsama Fire Brigade and other fire brigades from various Barangays in Taguig City, responded to the said fire incident which was reported around 7:30 in the evening of Tuesday, March 24.

The BFP raised the alarm immediately to 2nd alarm at around 7:35pm and raised again to 3rd alarm on 7:44pm due to the areas being engulfed in flames.

It was later declared Fire under Control at 8:30pm and Fire out at 9:00pm by the BFP. | via Vince Lopez

👉 For the latest news, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI

• DTR / 240 St — Partial closure  
• Fern Crescent @ 236 St — Full closure  (BC Hydro on scene)
